table_title: Daily discharge, in second-feet, into Crane Valley reservoir near North Fork, Cal., for 1910-11.
site_name: Crane Valley reservoir near North Fork, Cal.
location_text: Crane Valley reservoir was formed by constructing a dam on North Fork of San Joaquin River in the E. ½ sec. 26, T. 7 S., R. 22 E.
notes: Sampled table 3 is the bottom block of the page: Oct.-Dec. 1911 (three day-groups side by side), a continuation of the one printed table whose title at the top of page 208 says 1910-11; the upper blocks cover Apr.-Sept. 1910 and Oct. 1910-Sept. 1911. Years given are for the sampled block only (1911); the whole printed table spans 1910-1911. Site name is in the title on the same page (named place: near North Fork, Cal.); the section-township-range is in the station description on scan page 207 (printed p. 199) and locates the dam. Water type is ambiguous: the quantity is daily inflow to a reservoir in second-feet (typed Stream Discharge; Reservoir is the alternative). No station number, no county printed. A few digits are faint (e.g. day 29 label, Nov. 9-10 values 75 and 70).
